arxiv-2108-11474.title: Graded Galois Lattices and Closed Itemsets Thanks: This article has been derived from the Ph. D. thesis by the first author under the supervision of the second author at Yasouj University , Yasouj, Iran.
arxiv-2108-11474.creator: Reza Sotoudeh, Hamidreza Goudarzi, Ali Akbar Nikoukar
arxiv-2108-11474.description: Abstract The Galois lattice is a graphic method of representing knowledge structures. The first basic purpose in this paper is to introduce a new class of Galois lattices, called graded Galois lattices. As a direct result, one can obtain the notion of graded closed itemsets (sets of items), to extend the definition of closed itemsets.

arxiv-2110-01678.title: Dedication
arxiv-2110-01678.creator: For Emma, forever ago.
arxiv-2110-01678.description: Abstract We consider a finite dimensional quantum system S S in an arbitrary initial state coupled to an infinitely extended quantum thermal reservoir R R in equilibrium at inverse temperature β \beta . The coupling is given by a bounded perturbation of the dynamics and the coupling strength is controlled by a parameter λ \lambda .

arxiv-2208-11815.title: A tensor decomposition model for evaluating isotopic yield in neutron-induced fission
arxiv-2208-11815.creator: Qufei Song, Long Zhu, Jun Su, Hui Guo
arxiv-2208-11815.description: Abstract Background Due to the complex multidimensional dependence, the prediction and evaluation of independent fission yield distributions have always been a challenge. Purpose Considering the complex multidimensional dependence and high missing rate of independent yield data, this work applies the tensor decomposition algorithm to the prediction of independent fission yields.

arxiv-2304-13531.title: Integrated Architecture for Neural Networks and Security Primitives using RRAM Crossbar
arxiv-2304-13531.creator: Simranjeet Singh 1 5 § , Furqan Zahoor 2 § , Gokulnath Rajendran 2 , Vikas Rana 5 , Sachin Patkar 1 , Anupam Chattopadhyay 2 , Farhad Merchant 3
arxiv-2304-13531.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Simranjeet Singh 1 5 § , Furqan Zahoor 2 § , Gokulnath Rajendran 2 , Vikas Rana 5 , Sachin Patkar 1 , Anupam Chattopadhyay 2 , Farhad Merchant 3. This paper proposes an architecture that integrates neural networks (NNs) and hardware security modules using a single resistive random access memory (RRAM) crossbar.

arxiv-2305-09025.title: Soft Prompt Decoding for Multilingual Dense Retrieval Conference: Proceedings of the 46th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval; July 23–27, 2023; Taipei, Taiwan Proceedings of the 46th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development i
arxiv-2305-09025.creator: Zhiqi Huang, Hansi Zeng, Hamed Zamani, James Allan
arxiv-2305-09025.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zhiqi Huang, Hansi Zeng, Hamed Zamani, James Allan. In this work, we explore a Multilingual Information Retrieval (MLIR) task, where the collection includes documents in multiple languages. We demonstrate that applying state-of-the-art approaches developed for cross-lingual information retrieval to MLIR tasks leads to sub-optimal performance. This is due to the heterogeneous and imbalanced nature of multilingual collections – some languages are better represented in the collection and some benefit from large-scale training data.

arxiv-2311-14811.title: The Message Complexity of Distributed Graph Optimization
arxiv-2311-14811.creator: Fabien Dufoulon, Shreyas Pai, Gopal Pandurangan, Sriram V. Pemmaraju, Peter Robinson
arxiv-2311-14811.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Fabien Dufoulon, Shreyas Pai, Gopal Pandurangan, Sriram V. Pemmaraju, Peter Robinson. The message complexity of a distributed algorithm is the total number of messages sent by all nodes over the course of the algorithm. This paper studies the message complexity of distributed algorithms for fundamental graph optimization problems. We focus on four classical graph optimization problems: Maximum Matching ( MaxM ), Minimum Vertex Cover (MVC), Minimum Dominating Set (MDS), and Maximum Independent Set ( MaxIS ).

arxiv-2403-00683.title: Lessons learned from NASA’s DART impact about disrupting rubble-pile asteroids
arxiv-2403-00683.creator: S. D. Raducan, M. Jutzi, C. C. Merrill, P. Michel, Y. Zhang, M. Hirabayashi, A. Mainzer
arxiv-2403-00683.description: Abstract We present a series of numerical simulations using a shock physics smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH) code, investigating energetic impacts on small celestial bodies characterised by diverse internal structures, ranging from weak and homogeneous compositions to rubble-pile structures with varying boulder volume packing. Our findings reveal that the internal structure of these rubble-pile bodies significantly influences the impact outcomes.

arxiv-2403-20087.title: Unobserving the Moon: the spurious possibility of orbital decoupling due to solar neutrino Arago spot
arxiv-2403-20087.creator: Henrik Viitasaari, Oskari Färdig, Joona H. Siljander, A. Petrus Väisänen, Aapo S. Harju, Antti V. Nurminen, Jami J. Kinnunen
arxiv-2403-20087.description: Abstract The Arago spot is an intensity maximum at the center of a shadow created by constructive interference of diffracted waves around a spherical object. While the study of diffraction patterns usually concerns visible light, De Broglie’s wave nature of matter makes diffraction theory applicable for particles, such as neutrinos, as well.

arxiv-2408-08842.title: Phase-Separated Charge Order and Twinning Across Length Scales in CsV 3 Sb 5
arxiv-2408-08842.creator: Jayden Plumb, Andrea Capa Salinas, Krishnanand Mallayya, Elliot Kisiel, Fellipe B. Carneiro, Reina Gomez, Ganesh Pokharel, Eun-Ah Kim, Suchismita Sarker, Zahirul Islam, Sam Daly, Stephen D. Wilson

Carneiro, Reina Gomez, Ganesh Pokharel, Eun-Ah Kim, Suchismita Sarker, Zahirul Islam, Sam Daly, Stephen D. Wilson. britannica-1911-moron-de-la-frontera.description: Article 'Morón de la Frontera' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. the eastward are the ruins of the ancient castle, of considerable importance during the Moorish period, when Morón, as its full name implies, was a frontier fortress; the castle was afterwards used as a palace by the counts of Urena. pmc-10553067.title: Predictive value of tumor mutational burden for PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors in NSCLC: A meta-analysis
pmc-10553067.creator: Wenjie Li, Yanjun Zhao, Hongjun Zhang, Wenying Zheng, Ruixuan Wang, Xing Gu
pmc-10553067.description: Background:To investigate the association between tumor mutational burden (TMB) and the therapeutic effect of Programmed Death 1/Programmed Death Ligand 1 inhibitors in non-small cell lung cancer.Methods:Four electronic databases, PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and Cochrane Library, were searched on May 10, 2023, and no time limitation was applied. Analyses were performed using STATA17.0.

pmc-10632610.title: Late fetal hematopoietic failure results from ZBTB11 deficiency despite abundant HSC specification
pmc-10632610.creator: Huimin Cao, Shalin H Naik, Daniela Amann-Zalcenstein, Peter Hickey, Agus Salim, Benjamin Cao, Susan K Nilsson, M Cristina Keightley, Graham J Lieschke
pmc-10632610.description: Key Points•Zbtb11 is crucial for HSC function in establishing and maintaining early murine hematopoiesis.•Absence of Zbtb11 in the hematopoietic compartment leads to dysregulation of niche and oxidative phosphorylation genes. Introduction Hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) are characterized by the dual hallmarks of stemness: producing daughter HSCs (self-renewal) and/or daughter progenitor cells (differentiation).

pmc-11354050.title: Impact of the FreeStyle Libre 2® System on Glycaemic Outcomes in Patients with Type 1 Diabetes—Preliminary Study
pmc-11354050.creator: Katarzyna Rutkowska, Agnieszka Łoś-Stegienta, Michał Bagiński, Ewa Zięba, Adrianna Baran, Monika Żurawska-Kliś, Marcin Kosiński, Katarzyna Cypryk, Aw Tar-Choon
pmc-11354050.description: We aimed to evaluate glycaemic control in patients with type 1 diabetes during the first three months of use of the flash glucose monitoring (FGM) system. Methods: We conducted a study of a cohort of 81 people with type 1 diabetes mellitus who used the FreeStyle Libre 2 (FSL2) sensor continuously for 3 months.

pmc-11391628.title: Discovering common pathogenetic processes between periodontitis and Alzheimer’s disease by bioinformatics and system biology approach
pmc-11391628.creator: Fei Ge, Yang Zhao, Jinren Zheng, Qun Xiang, Pei Luo, Lu Zhu, Huiyu He
pmc-11391628.description: BackgroundThere is increasing evidence that inflammation plays a key role in the pathophysiology of periodontitis (PT) and Alzheimer’s disease (AD), but the roles of inflammation in linking PT and AD are not clear. Our aim is to analyze the potential molecular mechanisms between these two diseases using bioinformatics and systems biology approaches.

pmc-11415834.title: Unilateral secondary middle turbinate and ipsilateral bifid inferior turbinate with presence of uncinate process: Is it true bifid inferior turbinate?
pmc-11415834.creator: Melissa L Thenata, Anggraini D Sensusiati
pmc-11415834.description: Anatomical variations of the nasal turbinate, such as secondary middle turbinate (SMT) and bifid inferior turbinate (BIT), are sporadic. In most cases, SMT and BIT are generally bilateral. Moreover, the uncinate process is unusual in BIT because it is widely acknowledged that BIT could be an abnormality of the uncinate process.

pmc-11521214.title: Predictors of Feeding Tube Placement in Infants with Congenital Diaphragmatic Hernia: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Cohort Studies
pmc-11521214.creator: Yodya Evila, Anthony Ekaputra, Nicolas Daniel Widjanarko, Jessica Felicia Ang
pmc-11521214.description: The early stages of life pose feeding challenges for infants with Congenital Diaphragmatic Hernia (CDH), necessitating feeding tube placement to prevent growth failure. Predicting the factors prompting this intervention has yielded inconclusive findings in prior research. Thus, this review explored prenatal, perinatal, and postnatal variables associated with feeding tube placement in CDH.

pmc-11657171.title: The relationship between delivery fear and childbirth experience with the level of adherence to the WHO recommendations for a positive childbirth experience in Iranian women: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11657171.creator: Fatemeh Shabani, Solmaz Ghanbari Homaie, Fatemeh Yousefi Tabaei, Maryam Montazeri, Fatemeh Raphi, Elnaz Lalezari, Mojgan Mirghafourvand
pmc-11657171.description: BackgroundChildbirth experience is a unique event that involves psychological and physiological aspects influenced by social, environmental, organizational, and political factors. In 2018, the World Health Organization (WHO) introduced 56 recommendations for ensuring a positive childbirth experience at different stages of labor and delivery.

pmc-12476849.title: Incidence, Clinical Characteristics and Outcomes of Persistent Staphylococcus aureus Bacteremia in a Chinese Tertiary Care Hospital: A Single-Center Retrospective Study
pmc-12476849.creator: Dandan Wu, Jiongfei Jin, Jiachang Cai
pmc-12476849.description: PurposePersistent Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia (pSAB) poses significant clinical challenges because of its association with poor outcomes, including relapse and mortality. Despite its clinical importance, data on pSAB in the mainland Chinese population remain limited. This study aimed to investigate the prevalence, clinical characteristics, and predictors of pSAB in a tertiary hospital in China.

pmc-12694865.title: Association between triglyceride-glucose index and nephrolithiasis among the elderly in Amirkola: A cross-sectional population-based study
pmc-12694865.creator: Parsa Aghajani, Seyed Reza Hosseini, Ali Bijani, Reza Ghadimi
pmc-12694865.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background:Kidney stones are a condition that is prevalent in the geriatric group and significantly impairs their quality of life. The formation of stones may be associated with insulin resistance, which can be measured using the triglyceride-glucose (TyG) index.Methods:This cross-sectional study was part of the second phase of the Amirkola Health and Ageing Project (AHAP) Cohort, which was initiated in 2011 with a focus on individuals aged 60 years and older.

pmc-12768832.title: PP86 Cost Effectiveness Of Maternal Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Prefusion F (RSVpreF) With Complementary Nirsevimab Versus Nirsevimab Alone For Preventing RSV Among Infants In Chile
pmc-12768832.creator: Rafael Bolaños, Juan Francisco Falconi, Ahuva Averin, Erin Quinn, Amy Law, Diana Mendes
pmc-12768832.description: IntroductionRSV is a leading cause of lower respiratory tract illness (LRTI) among infants in Chile. Nirsevimab was recommended for infants in 2023 to address the burden of RSV-LRTI. The cost effectiveness of maternal RSVpreF with complementary nirsevimab for infants, versus nirsevimab alone, for prevention of RSV-LRTI among infants in Chile was evaluated.

pmc-13188749.title: Depression among nursing students in Pakistan: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13188749.creator: Hamideh Ebrahimi, Masoud Mohammadnezhad, Ghazala Irshad
pmc-13188749.description: BackgroundDepression is a common psychological disorder that adversely affects emotional functioning, motivation, and academic performance. Nursing students are at increased risk due to academic load, clinical responsibilities, and frequent exposure to patient suffering. In Pakistan, cultural expectations, financial pressure, and stigma surrounding mental health may further exacerbate vulnerability.

pmc-13250356.title: Rhesus blood group haplotype determination by nanopore sequencing and adaptive sampling enables the precise determination of complex allele combinations that could not be accurately determined by standard methods
pmc-13250356.creator: Rebekka Waldmann, Marita Führer, Annika Vogt, Dominik Nolde, Melanie Riecker, Lennart Finn Herrlich, Timo Dinse, Hubert Schrezenmeier, Christof Weinstock, David Alexander Christian Messerer
pmc-13250356.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPatients with chronic transfusion needs such as those with sickle cell disease face a high risk of developing antibodies against high‐prevalence antigens in the RH blood group system, complicating transfusion therapy and potentially necessitating stem cell transplantation.

pmc-13336539.title: Protective Role of Octreotide in Acute and Chronic Lung Injuries
pmc-13336539.creator: Ghasem Zarei, Zahra Pezeshki, Samira Choopani, Behnoush Mohammadi, Ardeshir Talebi, Mehdi Nematbakhsh
pmc-13336539.description: Background:The treatment of acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) has been the prominent concern in the clinic. Special attentions have been made to investigate the pathophysiological and pharmacological aspects of acute and chronic lung injuries. Appropriate drug treatment is the first priority in the treatment process of this disease.

pmc-13430486.title: Development and qualitative formative assessment of pictorial paper-based and digital carbohydrate-counting educational resources for diabetes management
pmc-13430486.creator: Getrude Mphwanthe, Bridget Mkama, Humphrey Chatenga, Lydia Lowe, Lorraine Weatherspoon
pmc-13430486.description: Introduction:Tailored carbohydrate-counting (CC) resources are helpful for diabetes self-management from an educator and patient perspective. Because these resources are unavailable in Malawi, we developed both pictorial paper-based and mobile app CC resources and explored clinical dietitians’ perceptions of these resources after using them in routine clinical practice.

pmc-13543951.title: Active site motifs of the Nem1 protein phosphatase confer its function in yeast lipid synthesis
pmc-13543951.creator: Emily R. Bostrom, Ruta Jog, Geordan J. Stukey, Gil-Soo Han, George M. Carman
pmc-13543951.description: The Nem1-Spo7 protein phosphatase complex plays a pivotal role in the lipid metabolism of Saccharomyces cerevisiae by activating Pah1, which catalyzes the dephosphorylation of phosphatidate to produce diacylglycerol for the synthesis of triacylglycerol and the phospholipids phosphatidylcholine and phosphatidylethanolamine. As the catalytic subunit, Nem1 dephosphorylates Pah1 to facilitate its membrane localization for phosphatidate phosphatase activity.

pmc-13632936.title: Feasibility and Usability of Home-Based Visual Evoked Potential Electroencephalogram in Neurological Telemonitoring Research
pmc-13632936.creator: Annemijn S.J.C. Oosterlee, Jet A.C. Jongenelen, Merel J. Kroon, Jamie L. Duijvelshoff, Paul Koster, Mark Ruit, Gisela M. Terwindt
pmc-13632936.description: Highlights •A home-based visual evoked potential EEG (VEP-EEG) system was developed to help predict migraine attacks.•Complex telemonitoring in a research setting has been shown to be feasible.•The improved VEP-EEG setup, with direct feedback on electrode connection, demonstrates good usability and user-friendliness for home-based research. Introduction Telemedicine and e-health solutions are increasingly recognized as effective options in migraine care.

pmc-13650521.title: Acute trazodone treatment ameliorates behavioral abnormalities and improves subsequent short‐term memory in a lipopolysaccharide‐induced mouse model of acute brain dysfunction
pmc-13650521.creator: Hideki Matsuoka, Leo Gotoh, Hikaru Hori
pmc-13650521.description: AimSystemic inflammation‐associated acute brain dysfunction, typified by delirium, is linked to later cognitive impairment. Although trazodone is used clinically for delirium‐related symptoms, its effects on subsequent cognition remain unclear. We examined whether acute‐phase trazodone treatment influences behavioral abnormalities, later cognitive outcomes, and inflammatory/glial‐related changes in an lipopolysaccharide (LPS)‐induced mouse model.MethodsAdult male C57BL/6J mice received saline or LPS (3.0 mg/kg, intraperitoneally).
